readme.run: Convert microscopy TIFF, PNG/JPEG sequences or NIfTI to multiscale OME-Zarr
notes: Input is a TIFF, OME-TIFF, NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz), or a PNG/JPEG/TIFF slice sequence.
Choose --version 0.5 (default, .ozx) or 0.4 (.ome.zarr.zip), and --format archive or dir.
Choose --method mean (default, intensity) or nearest (label masks).
Add --help for every option: chunk size, compression level, and overwrite.
No network connection is required and no external models are downloaded.
Please cite Moore et al. 2021 (OME-NGFF) and Moore et al. 2023 (OME-Zarr).
